en: Dependent on a mental state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive, there arises a state that is neither non-demonstrable nor non-reactive and is not mental,
by way of root condition. Dependent on a mental state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive, there arises a state that is neither non-demonstrable nor non-reactive and is not mental,
by way of root condition …pe… dependent on a mental state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive.

Dependent on states that are invisible and non-reacting, as well as those that are neither visible nor reacting and are not mental, there arise states that are invisible and non-reacting and are not mental by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated.
There are six [conditions] in the case of roots, three in the case of objects, ... pe ... and six in the case of non-disappearance.
